label: For "DevTools Agent Action Guardrails": Control every action AI coding agents take in source repositories, build pipelines and package registries, enforce approval tiers and give security reviewers a replayable record of each change. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Prompt-only restrictions.
